statement: The alternate extra CM pair has explicit automorphisms on the next class-two exponent quotients with two-kernel orders2^9603 and2^14356. Their corrected1,816,936- and4,448,112-letter cusp words are verified in full Z/4 and Z/8 Magnus models. The two-level correction module stabilizes for every higher exponent: its mod2 rank is4738 and its exact Bockstein map has rank15 onto the entire obstruction space. A one-level-lookahead correction therefore constructs an actual compatible action on the whole relative class-two pro2 completion, fixing the H2 action induced by the new Z4 certificate. It extends over every odd relative pro-p kernel and, through the exact common quotient of D.28, over the compatible mixed-prime quotient J.
depends_on: exact characteristic Magnus quotient models proved in D.29
notes: For H^(k)=B/(gamma3N [N,N]^(2^k) N^(2^(k+1))), the kernel order is2^(4753k+97). C_k=ker(H^(k+1)->H^(k-1)) is an abelian G2-module (Z/4)^4753; its reduction is the Q-module in D.27. Its action matrices and multiplier column are exactly constant modulo4 for k>=2. The4769-dimensional previous correction relation space maps onto the15-dimensional obstruction space at both the first and stabilized steps. Corrections at stagek fix levelk-1, so every finite level stabilizes and the limit is an actual automorphism. The first correction can change D.27's central H2 representative; the retained H2 action is explicitly the reduction of d_cm_exponent4.json. The original homology parities, including the right-centralizer correction, and original G3 conjugators are retained. Every odd relative pro-p action is identity with coprime order2 centralizer lifts. The quotient maps and D.28 compatibility give J times_C R. No genuine full profinite lift or full CM coset realization is claimed; further two-primary nonabelian and mixed finite refinements remain unresolved. D.30 subsequently excludes the particular H1 representative retained here as a genuine full lift, despite this entire infinite quotient action. It replaces its central coordinates explicitly and obtains the additional compatible degree6 quotient; the original certificates remain saved.
